 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order
% 18.12.2023 Crl.M.A. 34658/2023 (for exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The petitioner, vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973
, seeks quashing of FIR No.271/2011 dated 24.09.2011 registered under Sections 420/467/468/471/120-B IPC at P.S. North Rohini, Delhi.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
He seeks, and is granted, four weeks to file the Status Report.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 01:12:53 6.

On the petitioner taking requisite steps within two weeks, issue notice to the respondent no.2 by all permissible modes, returnable on 03.04.2024.
7.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J DECEMBER 18, 2023/rr
This is a digitally signed order.
